preconditions.description: The number of vertices n is between 1 and 50 inclusive.
There are exactly n-1 edges provided, forming a tree.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= u <= n and 1 <= v <= n and 1 <= w <= 50 for u, v, w in edges)
preconditions.description: Each edge connects valid vertices with a positive weight between 1 and 50.
The policeman's starting vertex s is valid.
The number of criminals m is between 1 and 50 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= x <= n and x != s for x in criminals)
preconditions.description: Each criminal starts at a valid vertex distinct from the policeman's start.

postconditions.expression: output == 'Terrorists win' if any(dist(s, c) <= dist(s, neighbor) for c in criminals for neighbor in neighbors(c) if dist(s, neighbor) < dist(s, c)) else str(min_time)
postconditions.description: Output is 'Terrorists win' if any criminal can escape to a subtree branch where the policeman cannot intercept them (i.e., the criminal is closer to the branch's root than the policeman), otherwise it is the minimum time required to catch all criminals.
If a solution exists, the output integer equals the minimum time required for the policeman to visit all necessary subtrees to catch all criminals, assuming optimal play from both sides.
